title: NameError
kicker: Python for SDFs · Fix the error

notes.label: NameError
notes.text: The type of error. Python met a name that has never been given a value in this session.

notes.label: name 'issue_dates' is not defined
notes.text: The name it couldn't find. In this notebook, `issue_dates` is created in the cell above this one. That cell hasn't run since the runtime started, so Python has never seen the name. It happens after a restart, or when you run cells out of order.

fixes.label: Run the cell above that creates issue_dates, then this one
fixes.title: Best fix
fixes.feedback: Python only knows what has already run in this session, not what's written on the page. Run the earlier cell first (Runtime > Run before runs every cell above this one), then this cell. It prints `Found 2 dates` and the two dates.
fixes.fixed_code:
issue_dates = ["2023-04-12", "2021-09-30"]
print(f"Found {len(issue_dates)} dates")
for date in issue_dates:
    print(date)

fixes.label: Add issue_dates = [] as the first line of this cell
fixes.title: The error goes away, but the answer is wrong
fixes.feedback: The cell now prints `Found 0 dates`, because you replaced the real dates with an empty list. The cell that finds the dates still hasn't run.
fixes.fixed_code:
issue_dates = []
print(f"Found {len(issue_dates)} dates")
for date in issue_dates:
    print(date)

fixes.label: Restart the session, then run only this cell
fixes.title: Still a NameError
fixes.feedback: A restart clears every variable. Python knows even less afterwards, so this cell fails the same way until the cell above runs.

_note: traceback from IPython 7.34 / Python 3.12 (kernel output, only the temp-file path shortened to <ipython-input-2>); confirm against a live Colab run
